name: dynon bach teg
text: dynon bach teg is a Welsh phrase that translates as fair little folk, with the plural form dynion bach teg. It serves as a Welsh-language name for the tylwyth teg, the fairies of Welsh tradition.

attributes.attribute: Welsh term meaning fair little folk, used as a synonym for the tylwyth teg

okr.objective: dynon bach teg is recorded as the Welsh phrase for fair little folk and as a synonym for the tylwyth teg.
